market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Converging oil spike, Fed rate hike, and geopolitical escalation create headwinds. S&P 500 testing inflection point. Expect 5-8% volatility in equities. Bond yields likely to rise further. Oil may test new highs if pipeline remains closed. SaaS names face continued selling pressure from GPT-6 fears.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure capex cycle remains intact (Nvidia, AMD). Aerospace recovery structural. Energy transition M&A (Essar, Dangote) signals long-term demand. However, rate environment and geopolitical risk cap upside. 6-12 month view favors quality, cash-generative names over speculative growth.
